title: Privacy Policy
description: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This page explains how distromatch collects, uses, and protects your information.
updateNotice: We may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Please check this page periodically for the latest changes. By continuing to use distromatch services, you agree to the applicable policy.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
items: Name and email address provided during registration.
Name and email from your Google account if using Google Login.
Quiz results and calculation data related to quizzes on distromatch.

sections.title: 2. How We Collect Data
items: Through registration forms with email validation (verification link sent to email).
From participating in quizzes available on the site.

sections.title: 3. Data Usage
items: Name and email data are used for registration, login, and identification of legitimate users.
DSS (Decision Support System) results are stored for system analysis and calculation audit purposes.
DSS results may be shared publicly via a special link, which only displays calculations without user's personal data.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking
items: Distromatch only uses cookies for authentication refresh token purposes.
No third-party cookies, tracking, or other analytics are used.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing and Retention
items: We do not share user data with third parties, partners, or for advertising purposes.
All data is used exclusively for internal purposes within the framework of research and system development.
We store data as long as your account is active or as long as necessary for service and research purposes.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
items: We strive to maintain the confidentiality of user data and implement reasonable security measures, but we cannot guarantee absolute security of your data on the internet.

sections.title: 7. User Rights
items: Users can access, update, or delete their personal data using the features provided.

sections.title: 8. Service Area
items: This website is available to users worldwide and supports Indonesian and English.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.paragraph: If you have questions regarding privacy, please contact us via the email available at the bottom of the site or through the message form on the about page.
